title: 第十三章 月黑风高杀人夜第十四章 我这可没有误会
content_zh:
接下来的两日，苏阎过得很规律。
白天，在洞府前的空地上打拳。
从天蒙蒙亮打到日头偏西。
太虚龙象拳的每一记出手都牵动全身筋骨，蛮牛低吼之声在后山回荡。
打碎的石头换了一批又一批，空地上到处是拳印和裂痕。
到了夜里，便回洞府与林安修炼《阴阳赋》。
头一天晚上，林安还能撑住，虽然脸上羞得通红，但好歹没太抗拒。
第二天夜里，阴阳二气的流转比前一晚更猛烈，法力在两人体内反复冲刷经脉的感觉对凡人来说并不好受。
第三天，她就缩在石床里侧，死活不肯出来。
“少爷，我真的……真的不行了。”声音从被子底下传出来，闷闷的，带着几分哭腔，“浑身上下跟散了架一样，骨头缝里都是酸的。”
苏阎没有强求。
连日的采补对林安的负担太重，这丫头毕竟只是个凡人之躯，不比修士的体魄。
逼急了伤了根本，往后反而更难恢复。
不过好在，这几日不算白忙。
丹田之中，那团气旋已经膨胀到了一个临界状态，真气在经脉里游走时能感觉到一层薄薄的壁障，那是炼气二层与三层之间的关隘。
就差一口气。
差的不是悟性，不是时间，而是真气的总量。
就差最后那一股，把气旋撑破这层壁障，他就能迈入炼气三层。
苏阎站在洞府前的空地上，收回最后一拳。
拳风掠过地面，卷起一蓬碎石。

打了快两个时辰，从肩膀到指尖都在发颤，手背上的皮肤泛着不正常的暗红，筋肉在皮下跳个不停。
他没有再继续。
没有灵膳补充，身体的消耗已经到了一个危险的边缘。
骨骼在叫，肌肉在叫，胃更在叫。
回元丹在昨天就吃完了最后一颗，那个骷髅头储物袋里现在比他的脸还干净。
苏阎甩了甩手，靠在洞口的石壁上坐下来。
今天晚上就是第三天了。
山羊胡那句“下次我们再来”不是客套话。
这帮人做的是吃新人的营生，拖太久变数就多，第一次上门已经摸过底了，一个炼气一层的新人，怂，好说话，掏了瓶丹药就把他们打发走了。
在他们的盘算里，苏阎已经被归进了软柿子的名单。
第二次登门，绝不会再客气。
按他们的习惯，今晚必然会来。
苏阎抬头看了看天，太阳已经掉到了山脊的另一边，后山的阴影从坡顶往下铺。
林安今天一整天都没出洞府。
content_en:
Su Yan spent the next two days very regularly.
During the day, boxing was held in the open space in front of the cave.
From dawn until the sun turns to the west.
Every move of Taixu Dragon Elephant Fist affects the muscles and bones of the whole body, and the roar of the bull echoes in the back mountain.
The broken stones changed batch after batch, and the open space was full of fist marks and cracks.
At night, he went back to the cave to practice "Yin Yang Fu" with Lin An.
The first night, Lin An could still hold on. Although his face was red with embarrassment, he didn't resist too much.
The next night, the flow of yin and yang energy was more intense than the previous night, and the feeling of mana repeatedly washing through the meridians in the two bodies was not pleasant for mortals.
On the third day, she huddled inside the stone bed and refused to come out.
"Master, I really... really can't survive." The voice came from under the quilt, muffled, with a hint of crying, "My whole body feels like it's falling apart, and the bones are all sore."
Su Yan didn't force it.
The burden of taking supplements for days was too heavy on Lin An. After all, this girl was just a mortal, not as strong as a monk.
If you push yourself too hard, you'll damage your roots, which will make it even harder to recover later.
Fortunately, these days are not in vain.
In the Dantian, the cyclone has expanded to a critical state. When the true energy travels in the meridians, a thin barrier can be felt, which is the barrier between the second and third levels of Qi refining.
Just one breath away.
The difference is not in understanding or time, but in the total amount of Qi.
All he needed was the last surge to push the cyclone through this barrier, and he would be able to enter the third level of Qi refining.
Su Yan stood in the open space in front of the cave and withdrew his last punch.
The fist wind swept across the ground, rolling up a pile of gravel.
After almost two hours of beating, I was trembling from my shoulders to my fingertips. The skin on the back of my hand was an abnormal dark red, and the muscles were beating under the skin.
He did not continue.
Without spiritual food supplements, the body's consumption has reached a dangerous edge.
The bones are roaring, the muscles are roaring, and the stomach is roaring.
He finished the last Pill of Recovery yesterday, and the skull storage bag is now cleaner than his face.
Su Yan waved his hand and sat down against the stone wall at the entrance of the cave.
Tonight is the third day.
Goatee's "We'll come again next time" is not a polite comment.
What this group of people do is to make a living off of newcomers. If it takes too long, there will be many variables. The first time they come, they have already touched the bottom. A newcomer who is at the first level of Qi refining, cowardly and easy to talk to, took out a bottle of elixir and sent them away.
In their calculations, Su Yan has been included in the list of soft persimmons.
The second time I visit, I will never be polite again.
According to their habits, they will definitely come tonight.
Su Yan raised his head and looked at the sky. The sun had already set on the other side of the ridge, and the shadow of the back mountain spread down from the top of the slope.
Lin An didn't leave the cave all day today.
